name: Snuffel
look: a small round sneezy mole in a velvet waistcoat with a big snuff-dusted pink nose and a snuff box
entry: Snuffel stores pulverized herbs in tiny pouches near its snout. A single pinch wakes it up instantly from hibernation.
how: Wild: common in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Sneeze Fit at level 17.
